text.p: These are the leading stories in the Angolan press on Wednesday.
Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- Thirty people were massacred by unidentified gunmen at the Catholic Mission of Kambondonglo, near the city of Cubal, over the weekend, and some 800 people have fled the area to Cubal, church sources in Benguela said yesterday.
- The Interior Ministry has named Eduardo Barber Octavio as the new head of the Directorate of Immigration and Frontiers, a Ministry spokesman said yesterday.
